# Prepared demonstration reports

These reports are manually prepared educational inputs, not outputs from a live Research Agent. Sources were checked on 2026-10-21. Exact short excerpts support each claim; verification means source support was reviewed, not that a claim is universally certain.

The AI Trends report is a dated snapshot of Stanford's 2026 AI Index findings, not a live news feed or a prediction. Publication dates are supplied only when visible in the source. Other pages may have update dates distinct from their initial publication dates.

The startup importer validates the shared ResearchReport contract. Existing reports are immutable: changed fixtures must use a new report UUID so historical content retains its original research input.
